description: Detect whether a web page has changed since the last check. Fetches a public URL, normalizes its main text and returns a sha256 hash, changed true/false against the previous_hash sent in (null on the first check), word count and fetch time. A one-shot change monitor for price, policy or docs pages. Each call is a single check; there are no webhooks or stored subscriptions. Price: $0.10 USDC per call (x402 on Base) or 1 prepaid pack credit. Failed calls aren't charged when you pay per call with x402: if the job errors, the USDC payment is never settled. With pack credits (X-Entitlement-Key), a call that fails gives its credit back.

previous_hash.description: sha256 from a previous watch-once call, to detect change
